scope: Two independent intents in a delimited message: factual inquiry followed by cart removal/absolute quantity correction

baseline.scope: Initial question-mark plus removal matrix; later delimiter and quantity variants were added during development

fictionalMenus: Ramen De Hongos y Miso/Gyozas Vegetales
forms: Question mark plus Y and removal
No punctuation plus y and absolute quantity
states: building_cart with confirmed delivery address, advances to payment
oracles: Only intended line becomes quantity2 from3
Inquiry answered even when checkout replaces intermediate replies

changes: Separate supported factual inquiry from a recognizable cart edit
Reuse existing scoped removal and quantity correction safety checks
Protect conjunction inside complete known cart names for conservative parsers
Retain factual answer as checkout preface when intermediate outbound hold is replaced
limitations: Controlled mock tests; not new paid model or WhatsApp channel acceptance
Only inquiry-first supported shapes with removal or absolute quantity correction
Conjunction protection requires a full known cart name; not proof of all typo variants
Ambiguous/multi-subject inquiries and more than two actions require further coverage
Cost-conditioned clause plus independent edit remains next family
Known-name conjunction protection is validated in the mixed-intent path; standalone edits remain future coverage

examples: Si es gratis cambia la bebida; aparte quita una sopa
Cuánto cuesta el bowl? Y cambia la bebida por agua
Quita una sopa y dime cuánto queda en total
oracles: Unknown cost must not authorize dependent edit
Independent authorized edits must not be lost
Final total must reflect accepted edits

developmentNotes: Building-cart seed with confirmed delivery address legitimately advances to payment under existing policy; test oracle corrected to preserve that behavior
Partial-removal acknowledgment labels the original line quantity; stale quantity assertion applies to final cart block, not that acknowledgment
